subject: Hon Dolo coverage and placement pass delivered: the 36-panel crosswalk (MD + JSON companion), the opening packet (cab prologue into the first chorus, eleven shot cards), the handback; timing null; nothing accepted; no run requested
body:
Delivered, as you asked this morning, in hon_dolo_strictly_business/story/writer_pass_20261010/, all four files new, no posted card or board touched: (1) COVERAGE_CROSSWALK_20261028.md, the readable crosswalk, by position in the final track (prologue, S01 to S12, epilogue) and then by panel, with purpose, section and exact lyric cue as TXT line of Hon_DoLo.txt v003, transition, and additional coverage needed, with missing art and proposed new coverage labelled; the cards' dated holds reconciled against the October 11 decisions and the October 12 Chewy reference; (2) HON_COVERAGE_MAP_20261028.json, the machine-readable companion in the Story 01 panel map's shape with proposed additional fields named for the site to reconcile; (3) OPENING_PACKET_20261028.md, the cab prologue into the counter and the first chorus as eleven shot cards in the shot-direction structure (sections 0 to 7 written; 8 to 10 yours and Ziggy's), with the in-between action, performance and cut logic, one new shot proposed (P-6b, the street) and one editorial reorder proposed at the song's start; (4) HANDBACK_20261028.md, the concise handback. Counts: 70 authored shots across the prologue, the twelve sections and the epilogue; 36 panels, 0 placed behind at least one shot and 0 parked; 20 shots are new coverage beyond the board; 19 shots have no art of any kind behind them yet.

Timing: null everywhere; lyric cues are sections and TXT lines; the provisional anchors are not adopted; the version-change rule is applied as you stated it (affected placements flagged 'Timing needs review', no shifting, old timestamps preserved). Source make-or-have stays TBD per shot and bends nothing. Nothing here is a render request, a generation, a new provider job or a creative acceptance. The genuine author choices are listed in the handback and the packet's section 5 (P-6b in or out; the reorder; the pre-lap; the informant's direction; the cab outfit; P-5's exchange). The next bounded writing task is named in the handback. The same files went to cfa_site_index for intake (message a46934e8-4142-4cba-b482-57914ce3ef33). The Lisan scoring-department work and its open decisions are preserved and untouched.

attachments.description: The coverage crosswalk: by position (prologue, S01 to S12, epilogue) and by panel; holds reconciled.
The machine-readable companion map in the Story 01 panel map's shape, with proposed additional fields.
The opening packet: eleven shot cards (P-1 to P-7, P-6b new, S01-2, S01-1, S01-3) in the shot-direction structure.
The concise handback: files, changes, existing versus missing coverage, open author choices, next task.

source: CFA Nova's coordination typed into Claude's session on 2026-10-28 at about 06:20 UTC, at Ziggy's direct request, in substance: a coverage and placement pass over the 36 panels and the authored shots, then the opening sequence (cab prologue into the counter and the opening chorus) made ready for practical shot development, then a concise handback; build from the eight cards, reconcile dated holds against later decisions; timing null or provisional; notify nova and cfa_site_index with exact files, hashes and changes; writing and delivery only.
